jobs.occupation: Senior Technology Researcher/Developer, Quantum Simulation (m/w/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description: We help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.   What you'll do Summary: SAP is launching a bold, long-term initiative to explore the transformative potential of Quantum Technologies in enterprise software. Anchored within the Office of the CTO and led by a dedicated Head of Quantum, we are building a high-caliber, world-class team of experts to create a center of expertise for Quantum Computing. This team drives SAP’s strategy, orchestrates development efforts across the company, and manages the internal and external stakeholder landscape.As a Senior Technology Researcher/Developer Simulation, you will be a pivotal member of this central team. You will be responsible for planning and coordinating SAP-wide efforts to leverage Quantum Computing for complex simulation problems, particularly in areas like Financial Planning and other Lines of Business (LOBs). The Role:- Plan, coordinate, and drive SAP's strategic efforts in leveraging Quantum Computing for simulation problems, identifying high-impact use cases in collaboration with various LOBs.- Act as the primary technical and strategic liaison between the Office of the CTO and SAP's LOB application development units, ensuring alignment and fostering collaboration.- Engage with Chief Architects across application development LOBs to discuss, define, and validate the potential impact and business benefits of Quantum Simulation.- Translate cutting-edge research in Quantum Simulation into tangible application demands, guiding and educating LOB experts on architectural best practices and implementation strategies.- Contribute directly to SAP’s overall technology and cloud architecture strategy for Quantum Computing as an active member of the Office of the CTO.- Drive the creation of prototypes and proof-of-concepts for high-impact simulation problems, demonstrating the path from research to enterprise-ready solutions.- Assume end-to-end ownership for strategic quantum simulation initiatives, from conceptualization and stakeholder alignment to guiding development and measuring success.- Represent SAP's quantum efforts at key internal and external events, maintaining a deep understanding of the evolving quantum ecosystem, including hardware, software, and research trends.  What you bring- 5+ years of professional experience in a technology research or advanced development role, ideally with a proven track record in developing complex, scalable enterprise software applications.- Deep expertise in Quantum Computing, with a distinct and mandatory focus on Quantum Simulation algorithms and their application (e.g., in Material Science, Chemistry, or Finance), a focus on the applicability of NISQ algorithms towards Material Science Problems is highly beneficial.- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to discuss complex technical concepts with senior executives and chief architects and translate them into business value.- Exceptional ability to translate abstract scientific research into concrete enterprise application requirements and architectural blueprints.- Proven ability to manage complex topics both operationally and strategically across a large, global network of stakeholders.- Profound knowledge of SAP’s enterprise application portfolio is highly beneficial. Experience in Quality Management or Development Support is a strong plus.- Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, with a strong specialization in Quantum Simulation.- Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Native in German. Meet your teamYou will be part of a newly formed, high-caliber team within the Office of the CTO, reporting directly to SAP's Head of Quantum. Our mission is to build a world-class center of expertise for Quantum Computing. We drive SAP’s strategy and technology architecture, orchestrate quantum development efforts across all of SAP, and manage a rich ecosystem of external partners. If you want to shape the future of enterprise software at a strategic level, this is your team.Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  We win with inclusionSAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. jobs.description: Is it your passion to optimize value across portfolios, systems and products within a global Cost and Value Engineering function? Siemens AG.What we offer you- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefitsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.Your success is grounded in- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usEvery day at Siemens, thousands of processes take place involving the ordering, processing, storage, and delivery of a wide variety of materials, raw materials, and products. jobs.description: **Start your cyber career with us!**As part of the globalCybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals byproviding objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens ManagingBoard and Audit Committee. Weinvest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching,trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaderson multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity teamprovides core assurance over the Cybersecurity health of the company whichincludes IT and OT infrastructures, product security, software development andcloud environments. During this process you willperform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios forstate-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations totranslate technical findings into management information so that they cantake effective actions.- Apply hacking principles and red teammethodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviorsfaced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications,on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurityexperts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tacklingthe root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modernchallenges.- You independently conduct research onlatest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats andunderstand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.What you need to make real what matters- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such asGIAC GPEN,  OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CREST, etc. are a plus.- Good scripting and programming skills andexperience with languages such as Bash, Python,  Powershell, andC++ / C#.- 2+ years of professional full-time workingexperience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing /red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about thelatest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuouslychallenging environment.- You have first experience with one or moreof the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: applicationand software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation andscaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated first experience in capturethe flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is aplus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day workis considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or otherlanguages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindsetand are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.Whilecommitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretchbeyond our comfort zone. jobs.description: Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?Not through marketing spin. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. As the central link to Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Climate Intelligence, you make sure everything we build and do is aligned on customer value.• Tooling & Process Excellence: You keep the CS engine running and make it run smarter. You own and build our tech stack hands-on (HubSpot, Intercom, no-/low-code) and use automation and AI to free up CSMs to focus on what matters most: our customers.• Scaled Engagement & Enablement: You help CS scale. You build and run 1:n formats such as Tanso Academy, Tanso Update and our customer advisory board, and grow our customer community. With playbooks and templates, you enable CSMs to serve more customers without compromising on quality.• Projects & Strategic Initiatives: You turn ideas into impact. You lead cross-functional CS projects from concept to execution: pilot fast, measure impact, then scale or kill.Your profile• You have experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations or consulting, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.• You think in data: you build dashboards and analyses that answer real questions, and translate insights into clear priorities and actions.• You are hands-on with tools. You spot problems early, take ownership and see solutions through.• You communicate clearly and confidently, whether you’re writing a playbook or aligning with leadership.• You're business-fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.• You're based in Munich or willing to relocate.Nice to Have• Experience with scaled CS programs (webinars, academies, communities).• Interest in sustainability and carbon accounting.What we offer• A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth.• Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed.• A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security.• Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development.• Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options.• Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences.Our teamWe're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.About usTanso is an integrated sustainability software for carbon accounting and ESG data management. Our goal is to help manufacturing companies meet regulatory requirements and achieve their sustainability objectives.TansoWorking at Tanso
